hook.voiceover: Four things blew up while you scrolled.

stories.headline: Anthropic just had the biggest IPO ever
stories.voiceover: Claude's maker Anthropic just had the biggest IPO ever. Shares opened thirty-four percent higher.
stories.concept: stock chart line rockets up and smashes through the top of the frame, +34% slams, Nasdaq-style bell rings
stories.source: CBS News, The Next Web (IPO $83, opened +34% (CBS: $111.50), closed $97.17 = +17%, ~$81B raised, largest IPO on record, Nov 19, ticker ANT)

photo.credit: Photo: Anthropic / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: Valve shut the 2TB Steam Machine waitlist
stories.voiceover: Valve closed the waitlist for its two-terabyte Steam Machine. Memory costs are soaring.
stories.concept: a queue of people marching toward a gate, a steel shutter slams down with OUT OF STOCK, RAM chip price tag spins into $???
stories.source: Valve Steam Hardware announcement (Nov 19), GamesRadar+, VGTimes

photo.credit: Photo: Steam / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: You can now edit an Instagram Story after posting
stories.voiceover: You can now edit Instagram Stories after posting. You get fifteen minutes, and keep your views.
stories.concept: phone with a story containing a typo, eraser zaps the typo, a 15:00 timer appears, view counter stays locked
stories.source: Adam Mosseri post via Gizmodo (Nov 18), Forbes Australia, India.com

photo.credit: Photo: Instagram / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: Google booked a rocket for AI in space
stories.voiceover: And Google booked a Blue Origin rocket to fly its AI computers to space, in early twenty twenty-nine.
stories.concept: a server rack straps onto a rocket, blasts off through clouds, unfolds giant solar wings in orbit, 2029 slams
stories.source: Via Satellite, Reuters via Yahoo Finance (New Glenn, Project Suncatcher, Q1 2029, TPU satellites ~ a data-center rack each)

photo.credit: Photo: Google LLC / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons
